contract.note: Counting a delivered, energized phase above 50 MW is a fair ordinary reading of completed data-center capacity. This completion-unit interpretation determines the construction-time result; the contract also respects the stated conversion exception.

evidence.note: The packet reports PDG's disclosure of a 52 MW phase delivered in 12 months and successfully energized. It contradicts the minimum duration under the contract's phase interpretation. This is a company disclosure, without independent commissioning verification.
Epoch's expectation of future gigawatt commissioning does not verify operational capacity by the statement date. It settles neither clause.

reviews.rationale: Under the fair phase-based reading, PDG's disclosed 52 MW completion in 12 months contradicts the universal 18–36 month range. The contract permits developer completion disclosures. The separate assertion that no operational gigawatt site existed remains unresolved; it is not established by Epoch's forecast.
